title: Causal-prior-constrained deep learning for rapid-intensification warning of western North Pacific tropical cyclones
abstract: arXiv:2610.40304v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rapid intensification (RI) is one of the most dangerous and unpredictable phases of tropical cyclones, and its environmental and structural drivers are difficult to identify and separate in observations. Here we introduce CausalVisionRI, a causal-prior-constrained deep-learning system for 24-h RI warning in the western North Pacific. It integrates infrared remote sensing imagery, atmospheric and oceanic fields, and an observationally discovered causal graph into a unified model. translated_title: 基于因果先验约束的深度学习实现西北太平洋热带气旋快速增强预警
translated_abstract: 快速增强（RI）是热带气旋中最危险且最难以预测的阶段之一，其环境与结构驱动因素在观测中难以识别和分离。本文提出了CausalVisionRI，一个面向西北太平洋24小时快速增强预警的因果先验约束深度学习系统。该系统将红外遥感影像、大气和海洋场以及通过观测发现的因果图整合到一个统一的模型中。该因果图及八项经过符号验证的24小时强度变化效应为训练提供了可审计的因果先验。该因果图基于2000-2017年的522个气旋发现，识别了连接大气和海洋条件、气旋动力与结构状态及其24小时强度变化之间的因果路径。在涵盖2020-2024年、共3,004条记录的前向留出测试集上，五成员集成模型相对于固定基准取得了0.259的Brier技巧评分（BSS）
tldr: 该研究提出CausalVisionRI系统，将观测发现的因果图及八项符号验证效应作为可审计的因果先验约束嵌入深度学习模型，融合红外遥感影像与大气海洋场数据，显著提升了西北太平洋热带气旋24小时快速增强预警的性能。
en_tdlr: The study proposes CausalVisionRI, a deep-learning system that embeds an observationally discovered causal graph with eight sign-verified effects as an auditable causal prior, integrating infrared remote sensing imagery with atmospheric and oceanic fields to substantially improve 24-hour rapid-intensification warning of western North Pacific tropical cyclones.
